title: Noughts & Crosses · Part 4 — Complete and test
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

questions.prompt: What does MakeMove() return after a successful move?
options: false.
There is not enough information to determine the result.
true.

questions.prompt: Why must an invalid move not switch player?
questions.answer: The same player needs another attempt.
options: There is not enough information to determine the result.
The same player needs another attempt.
The different player needs another attempt.
questions.feedback: Model answer: The same player needs another attempt.

questions.prompt: What row and column does move 8 map to?
How many winning lines exist on a 3 × 3 Noughts & Crosses board?
options: 9: 3 rows, 3 columns and 2 diagonals.
7: 3 rows, 3 columns and 2 diagonals.
8: 3 rows, 3 columns and 2 diagonals.
questions.feedback: Model answer: 8: 3 rows, 3 columns and 2 diagonals.

blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: Boolean — A data type with only two possible values: true or false.
Condition — An expression that evaluates to true or false.
State — The current data describing what is happening in the program.
Game loop — The repeated structure that controls turns until the game ends.
Test case — A chosen input and expected outcome used to check a program.
Trace — Following variables and control flow step by step.

blocks.title: HasWon() checks 8 lines
blocks.text: Each winning line needs three comparisons joined with && . The possible lines are joined with || .

blocks.title: BoardFull() looks for any free square
blocks.text: If even one square is free, the board is not full.

blocks.title: Finish Main()
blocks.text: Part 3 already handled valid moves and switching. Today we add the stopping conditions.

blocks.title: Can two pupils actually play it?
blocks.text: After completing the code, play against a partner and compare expected with actual results. Use planned board positions to test all eight winning lines.

blocks.title: Worked example · Build BoardFull()
blocks.text: Return true only when every square contains X or O.
